The bug in the code is that it skips the last item in the list when calculating the total. The fix is to change the loop to iterate over the range of the length of the list instead of the length minus one. The corrected code is:

```python
def summarize(items):
    total = 0
    for i in range(len(items)):
        total += items[i]
    return total
```
